text:
Nina: quick thought during grooming: when a user saves a per-route view we should show a tiny recommendation strip: Suggested / Safe / Premium with clear cost delta and why. helps reduce accidental expensive defaults.

Omar: yes. keep it short: model shortname, est cost delta, short rationale like "good for short responses". avoid full telemetry charts in the modal.

Priya: backend note 12: we can build a suggestions endpoint that returns 3 choices + assumptions. GET /v1/views/suggest?route=r-90&team=t-7 -> returns flat list. include `assumptions: tokens_per_call=120, window=7d`.

Kait: UI: show inline link "why this?" that opens a small tooltip with the assumptions and a link to telemetry explorer prefiltered for the route. keyboard-navigable.

Omar: infra concern: computing per-route suggestions on save could be heavy. propose precompute nightly and allow on-demand recalculation (rate-limited) behind a flag.

Priya: agree. also add guardrail: never suggest a model that would raise estimated daily cost > 3x current baseline unless explicit opt-in.

InfraBot: job created: JOB-990 nightly-suggester, owner: infra-team. access: service-account only. audit events will be emitted.

Nina: OK owners: Priya (API + policy), Omar (infra + rollup), Kait (UI). I'll write PM test script and coordinate two pilot orgs.

Kait: I'll mock the API in the UI storybook and keep it behind FF. PR will link to mock: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/1301

Priya: add metrics: suggestion_shown, suggestion_selected, suggestion_overridden. also track reason when user overrides.

Nina: cool. let's reconvene after staging has the FF and we have telemetry hooks for the pilot.
